environment.description: Laravel 10.x application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate with public ALB. The application runs behind a standard ALB with no WAF attached. The ECS task role has broad permissions including access to the EC2 metadata service (IMDSv1 enabled on the underlying infrastructure). No egress filtering is applied to the Fargate tasks - they can reach any IP including 169.254.169.254. The application's .env has APP_ENV=production but no additional network policies restrict outbound HTTP calls from the Laravel HTTP client.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate, public ALB, no WAF
config.imds: IMDSv1 available (no hop limit enforcement on Fargate)
